name: Abstract / Geometric
description: Bone ground with hard-edged vermilion, ultramarine and marigold primitives, heavy grotesque type and exact transformations; for abstract ideas and mathematical motion.

tokens.texture: Flat colour; optional fine grain; no gradients by default
tokens.spacing: --u = 1% of short side; --gap; safe-area insets per format

motion.personality: Exact and kinetic: rhythmic transformations, on-grid snaps with controlled overshoot
motion.notes: Motion is the content: derive timing from a repeating unit; avoid decorative drift.

contrast_checked: accent/paper is below 4.5:1: use for display type 24px+ equivalent, shapes and rules only; never for body or caption text

validation.evidence: Contrast ratios computed from the stylesheet hex values with src/pipeline/colorscience.py (WCAG 2.x), 2026-11-02. Not yet used in a rendered project.
